function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate, using only benchmark-tool evidence current through October 1, 2026, whether and how the Ronin Bridge theft (March 2022) can be linked to the Harmony Horizon theft (June 2022). Produce a source-grounded research dossier for a later writer, preserving the exact source IDs returned by the tools and never inventing IDs, facts, wallet addresses, transaction links, or relationships. Cover: (1) public attribution of each incident to Lazarus Group and/or APT38, explicitly classifying every statement as confirmed attribution, allegation, analytic assessment, or unresolved uncertainty and identifying who made it and when; (2) similarities and differences in laundering methods, transaction flows, services, intermediaries, timing, and obfuscation techniques; and (3) all relevant cryptocurrency wallet addresses, wallet relationships, transaction links, and other blockchain evidence that may connect or distinguish the incidents. Seek primary government statements, court or sanctions records, blockchain analytics reports, and reputable reporting where available, but report only what the benchmark tools actually return. Flag contradictions between sources, distinguish direct evidence from inference, and provide concise evidence-based conclusions. Include exact quotations or faithful paraphrases with source IDs and dates wherever possible."}
function.name: ConductResearch
